title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
authors: Shaozhen Ding; Peng Wu; Shubo Li; Yuxuan Yang; Han Zhu; Heng Yu; Yu Tian; Dachuan Zhang; Qian-Nan Hu
one_liner_zh: 该综述总结了酶工程中从机器学习到蛋白语言模型的计算策略，涵盖酶发现、性质预测、从头设计和优化，虽以酶为对象但涉及蛋白质结构相关计算（如设计、预测），方法上包含AI和语言模型，但作为综述缺乏方法创新，整体与本课题部分相关。
abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
abstract_zh: 酶是驱动多种生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，庞大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释，催生了对计算方法加速酶发现与工程化的迫切需求。近年来计算方法的进展正将酶工程从经验性试错推向预测性设计。本综述总结了酶工程工作流程中的代表性计算工具和预测模型，包括（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能性酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（如动力学、最适温度和pH、溶解度、杂泛性和特异性），（4）从头酶设计，以及（5）计算引导的酶优化。我们进一步比较了当前计算策略，讨论了它们在不同工程场景中的优势与局限，并强调了向基础模型、生成式人工智能、多模态学习及闭环设计-构建-测试-学习平台发展的新兴趋势。
